[Context: 1. Predictive Maintenance Rules]
MAINT-01, Sensor = VIB. MAINT-01, Station = ST04_PACKAGING. MAINT-01, Trigger = VIB DRIFT >0.05 mm/s over 60 min Inspect and lubricate bearing HIGH. MAINT-01, Action = VIB DRIFT >0.05 mm/s over 60 min Inspect and lubricate bearing HIGH. MAINT-01, Priority = VIB DRIFT >0.05 mm/s over 60 min Inspect and lubricate bearing HIGH. MAINT-02, Sensor = CUR. MAINT-02, Station = ST02_SEALING. MAINT-02, Trigger = CUR DRIFT >1.0 A for 30+ min Inspect sealing jaw. MAINT-02, Action = CUR DRIFT >1.0 A for 30+ min Inspect sealing jaw. MAINT-02, Priority = HIGH. MAINT-03, Sensor = TEN. MAINT-03, Station = ST03_LABELLING. MAINT-03, Trigger = TEN STUCK >10 samples. MAINT-03, Action = Replace sensor. MAINT-03, Priority = MEDIUM. MAINT-04, Sensor = PRS. MAINT-04, Station = ST01_FILLING. MAINT-04, Trigger = PRS <3.3 bar for >15 min. MAINT-04, Action = Inspect filter and pump. MAINT-04, Priority = MEDIUM. MAINT-05, Sensor = TMP. MAINT-05, Station = SRV01_SERVERROOM. MAINT-05, Trigger = TMP >25°C for >5 min. MAINT-05, Action = Activate secondary cooling. MAINT-05, Priority = CRITICAL. MAINT-06, Sensor = TMP. MAINT-06, Station = WRH01_WAREHOUSE. MAINT-06, Trigger = TMP DRIFT >2°C over 2 h. MAINT-06, Action = Inspect compressor; notify. MAINT-06, Priority = QC CRITICAL. MAINT-07, Sensor = TMP. MAINT-07, Station = CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE. MAINT-07, Trigger = TMP >20°C for >10 min. MAINT-07, Action = Emergency ventilation; notify. MAINT-07, Priority = safety officer CRITICAL. MAINT-08, Sensor = HUM. MAINT-08, Station = RND01_RDLAB. MAINT-08, Trigger = HUM DRIFT >10%RH over 60 min Activate dehumidifier; check HVAC drain HIGH. MAINT-08, Action = HUM DRIFT >10%RH over 60 min Activate dehumidifier; check HVAC drain HIGH. MAINT-08, Priority = HUM DRIFT >10%RH over 60 min Activate dehumidifier; check HVAC drain HIGH
